articles.summary: Net income of $196 million versus $403 million in the prior year quarter; core income of $203 million versus $409 million in the prior year quarter. PC core income of $397 million versus $456 million, reflects lower underlying underwriting results and higher catastrophe losses. Life Group core loss of $171 million versus $22 million in the prior year quarter, reflects an unfavorable after-tax impact of $137 million in 2026 from our annual long-term care reserve assumption updates. However, the unfavorable reserve assumption updates are almost entirely offset by a favorable economic impact from recent investment portfolio actions, the anticipated benefit of which is not reflected in current period earnings under GAAP accounting. Corporate Other core loss of $23 million versus $25 million in the prior year quarter. Net investment income of $635 million, reflects a $23 million decrease from limited partnerships and common stock to $48 million and a $20 million increase
